scope: Public wallet-authenticated Raydium CPMM Fee Key marketplace implementation with D1 persistence and bilateral atomic settlement construction. The deployed Workers/D1 service passed real authentication, replay/origin rejection and read-only protocol checks. Atomic settlement was executed separately on an isolated local validator. No Sona mainnet sale or security audit is attested.

runtime.hosted: Cloudflare Workers with D1 persistence and the existing HTML/CSS/JavaScript interface

network.settlementPrograms: Existing SPL Token, Associated Token and System programs

capabilities.listingPersistence: D1 in hosted implementation; SQLite in local reference service
capabilities.readOnlyFeeKeyVerification: GET /api/verify/:mint with optional tokenAccount query; live holder and canonical protocol checks without a wallet

supportedTradingIntegrations: Raydium CPMM Burn & Earn Fee Key secondary transfer

sourceEvidence.description: Live UI data and signed action handlers
Wallet adapters and client canonical transaction verification
RPC discovery and protocol-specific authenticity checks
Authentication, persistent listing and settlement lifecycle
Hosted HTTP routing and read-only verification endpoint

verification.artifactScope: Recorded artifacts carry source hashes. Run the offline readiness checker for current source correspondence; rerun the actual scripts after source changes.
verification.walletVerificationScope: Automated adapter and UI action tests; no independently observed extension session claimed
verification.hostedRuntimeScope: Actual public Workers/D1 HTTP authentication, nonce consumption, replay/origin rejection, session logout and live third-party Raydium reads are recorded separately from local-validator settlement. No public purchase or browser-extension session is claimed.
verification.referenceHolderScope: The recorded third-party reference Fee Key is held by a program address. It proves read compatibility, not support for selling that asset through the ordinary-wallet signing flow.

limitations: A seller must be available to approve each buyer. This is not an escrow-backed unattended fill.
Listings and purchase coordination are hosted by Sona; non-custodial settlement does not decentralize the order service.
Local tests use valueless SOL and purpose-created SPL NFTs. They are not mainnet Raydium sales.
The public mainnet Fee Key read concerns an unrelated holder and is not seeded as a listing or claimed as a Sona user.
No CLMM, partial-rights, redemption, fee claiming, new lock creation or confidential settlement support.
Public RPC is free to access without keys but can throttle or fail. Real network transactions still have fees.
No originality, first-to-market, security-audit, public-production-readiness or guaranteed-rating attestation is made.
Public runtime checks sent no blockchain transactions. A supported real Fee Key sale on the public network remains unverified.

publication.verification: Public deployment and source availability confirmed. Runtime checks cover HTTP/Workers/D1 authentication and read-only protocol verification; no marketplace settlement was sent.
